2026-07-28.content:
* **(Database Migration)** Made `--auto-commit` flag the default for `gcloud database-migration
  conversion-workspaces seed|convert|import-rules` operations. To disable
  auto-committing, use `--no-auto-commit` flag.

summary.title: Database Migration: Auto-commit is now default
summary.summary: The `--auto-commit` flag is now the default for several database migration operations, including `seed`, `convert`, and `import-rules`. To disable this behavior, use the `--no-auto-commit` flag.

2026-07-28.content:
* Fixed an issue where running `gcloud init` crashed when Enterprise Certificate Proxy (ECP) binaries were missing from configuration.
* Updated macOS Python Virtualenv for the `gcloud` CLI to 3.14.6.

summary.title: gcloud init crash fixed
summary.summary: The gcloud CLI has been updated to fix a crash when running gcloud init with missing Enterprise Certificate Proxy binaries. The macOS Python Virtualenv for the gcloud CLI has also been updated.

2026-07-28.content: * Promote AlloyDB Backup DR restore flags (`--backupdr-backup` and `--backupdr-data-source`) to the GA track.

summary.title: AlloyDB Backup DR restore flags now generally available
summary.summary: We are promoting the AlloyDB Backup DR restore flags, `--backupdr-backup` and `--backupdr-data-source`, to the GA track. This means these features are now fully supported and recommended for production use.

2026-07-28.content: * Fixed a bug where `gcloud biglake iceberg tables` commands failed to send the `X-Iceberg-Access-Delegation: vended-credentials` header.

summary.title: BigLake command fix
summary.summary: A bug has been fixed in BigLake where certain `gcloud` commands were not sending the correct header for Iceberg table access. This resolves an issue that prevented these commands from functioning correctly.

2026-07-28.content:
* Added `-f`/`--force` support to `bq rm --connection` to ignore NOT\_FOUND
  errors if the connection does not exist.
* Fixed reading configuration from `gcloud` CLI with `--nouse_google_auth` flag.
* Added a predefined label for jobs created in specific metrics environments.
* Updated the help text for several global flags.
* Updated command format in the user-agent HTTP header of API requests.

summary.title: BigQuery CLI improvements
summary.summary: The BigQuery command-line tool has been updated with new features, including force deletion for connections, improved configuration reading, predefined job labels, and updated help text and API request formatting.

2026-07-28.content: * Added `--log-retention-days` flag across `gcloud backup-dr backup-plans create` and `update` across all release tracks to enable Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) log retention configuration.

summary.title: Configure backup log retention
summary.summary: You can now configure log retention for point-in-time recovery with the new --log-retention-days flag. This flag is available for backup plans during creation and update across all release tracks.

2026-07-28.content:
* Added `--ignore-warnings` flag to `gcloud bigtable instances tables update` and `gcloud bigtable tables update`.
* Promoted `--ignore-warnings` flag of `gcloud bigtable materialized-views create` to GA.

summary.title: Bigtable: ignore warnings in table updates and materialized views
summary.summary: You can now use the `--ignore-warnings` flag with `gcloud bigtable instances tables update` and `gcloud bigtable tables update` commands. The `--ignore-warnings` flag for creating materialized views is now generally available.

2026-07-28.content: * Enabled Airflow CLI commands for Composer environments running Airflow 3.2.

summary.title: Airflow CLI commands now available for Composer
summary.summary: You can now use Airflow CLI commands directly with your Composer environments running Airflow 3.2. This provides greater flexibility and control over your workflows.

2026-07-28.content: * Promoted `enabled-for-users-groups` option for `--scim-usage` flag to beta in `gcloud beta iam workforce-pools providers`.

summary.title: Cloud IAM SCIM Usage Beta
summary.summary: The `enabled-for-users-groups` option for the `--scim-usage` flag in `gcloud beta iam workforce-pools providers` has been promoted to beta. This enhancement improves SCIM provisioning capabilities within Cloud IAM.

2026-07-28.content:
* Added `--sandbox-launcher` flag to `gcloud beta run jobs` and
  `gcloud beta run worker-pools` command groups to allow setting a container as
  sandbox launcher when creating or updating a Cloud Run job or a worker pool.

summary.title: Run jobs with custom sandbox launcher
summary.summary: You can now specify a custom container as a sandbox launcher for Cloud Run jobs and worker pools using the new `--sandbox-launcher` flag. This allows for greater control over the sandbox environment for your workloads.

2026-07-28.content:
* Added `--idle-action` flag to `gcloud alpha workstations configs create`,
  `gcloud alpha workstations configs update`, `gcloud beta workstations
  configs create`, and `gcloud beta workstations configs update` commands.

summary.title: Cloud Workstations idle action flag
summary.summary: New flags allow you to configure actions for Cloud Workstations when they are idle. This helps manage resources efficiently by automatically stopping or restarting workstations based on inactivity.

2026-07-28.content:
* Added `--network-tier` flag to `gcloud compute public-advertised-prefixes create` in beta.
* Added `--metadata-filter` flag to `gcloud compute forwarding-rules create` command across all release tracks.
* Added `--metadata-filter` flag to `gcloud compute forwarding-rules update` commands across all release tracks.
* Added `gcloud compute machine-images test-iam-permissions` command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine machine image in beta, preview, and GA.
* Promoted `regex_rewrite` support in `url_rewrite` block to beta for `gcloud compute url-maps`.
* Promoted the following `gcloud compute routers` command groups to GA:
  `add-named-set`, `add-named-set-element`, `download-named-set`,
  `get-named-set`, `list-named-sets`, `remove-named-set`,
  `remove-named-set-element`, and `upload-named-set`.
* Added `gcloud compute health-sources test-iam-permissions` command to test IAM permissions on a health source.
* Added `gcloud compute instant-snapshot-groups set-iam-policy` command to set the IAM policy for a Compute Engine instant snapshot group.
* Added `gcloud compute networks subnets test-iam-permissions` command in beta, preview, and GA.
* Added `gcloud compute image-views describe` command in beta.
* Added `gcloud compute snapshots test-iam-permissions` to test IAM permissions for Compute Engine snapshots.
* Added `gcloud compute interconnects attachments groups set-iam-policy` command to set IAM policy on an interconnect attachment group in beta, preview, and GA.
* Added `--internal-range` flag to `gcloud compute addresses create`
  to support allocating global internal IP addresses from an Internal Range
  for Private Service Connect.
* Updated `gcloud compute reservations hosts list` and `gcloud compute reservations hosts describe` to require `--reservation` when `--reservation-block` is specified.

summary.title: New Compute Engine features and updates
summary.summary: This update introduces new flags for network tiers and metadata filtering, along with enhanced IAM permission testing for various Compute Engine resources. It also includes advancements in machine images, URL rewrite capabilities, and the promotion of several router command groups to general availability. Additionally, new commands for managing health sources and instant snapshot groups are now available.

2026-07-28.content: * Updated `gcloud beta developer-connect account-connectors` commands to support Bring Your Own (BYO) and Bitbucket Cloud (BBC) connection types.

summary.title: Developer Connect Enhancements
summary.summary: New options for connecting your development accounts are now available. The `gcloud beta developer-connect account-connectors` commands have been updated to support Bring Your Own (BYO) and Bitbucket Cloud (BBC) connection types, offering greater flexibility for your development workflows.

2026-07-28.content:
* Promoted `--view`, `--memberships`, `--filter`, and `--sort-by` flags on
  `gcloud container fleet|hub config-management describe` command to `beta`.

summary.title: Fleet config management flags promoted to beta
summary.summary: The `--view`, `--memberships`, `--filter`, and `--sort-by` flags for the `gcloud container fleet config-management describe` command have been promoted to beta. This update enhances the command's capabilities for managing fleet configurations.

summary.title: New flag for connectivity tests
summary.summary: A new flag, `--source-dms-private-connection`, has been added to `gcloud network-management connectivity-tests`. This enhancement allows for more specific configuration of connectivity tests, particularly when dealing with private connections.

2026-07-28.content:
* Added the `--secret-type` flag to `gcloud secrets create` to support creating secrets of different types (e.g. Cloud SQL credentials).
* Added the `gcloud secrets enable-managed-rotation` command to enable managed rotation for a secret using Cloud SQL credentials.
* Added the `gcloud secrets rotate-secret` command to rotate a secret.

Subscribe to these release notes at <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce>.

summary.title: New secret management features
summary.summary: New features for secret management have been released, including support for different secret types with the `--secret-type` flag, enabling managed rotation for secrets like Cloud SQL credentials, and a new command to rotate secrets. You can subscribe to release notes for more updates.
